attchmntText: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Technocraft Industries India Limited has filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the audio recording of the conference call held to discuss financial performance for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company submitted the link to the audio recording pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The filing was made by Neeraj Rai, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Technocraft Industries announced the publication of newspaper advertisements for its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 13, 2026. Consolidated total income for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was 114,164.55 lakhs. Consolidated net profit after tax for the same period was 15,977.73 lakhs. Earnings per share for continuing operations was 70.47 rupees. Standalone total income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 34,708.31 lakhs. Standalone net profit after tax was 287.41 lakhs. Standalone earnings per share was 0.90 rupees. The full financial results are available on the NSE, BSE, and company websites.

attchmntText: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Technocraft Industries India Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 13, 2026. The presentation outlines the company's diversified operations across drum closures, scaffolding systems, aluminum formworks, textiles, and engineering services. It highlights a global market share of approximately 36 percent for steel drum closures and details manufacturing capacities, including 1500 metric tons per month for aluminum extrusions and 60,000 square meters per month for formworks. The document also describes the company's geographical presence in over 80 countries and its corporate social responsibility initiatives through the Shanti Seva Nidhi trust.

attchmntText: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 93,518.10 Lakhs. Net profit for continuing operations was 11,790.57 Lakhs. Total net profit including discontinued operations was 11,906.48 Lakhs. Basic and diluted earnings per share for continuing operations was 49.99. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was 1,71,839.77 Lakhs. Net profit for continuing operations was 25,742.72 Lakhs. Total net profit including discontinued operations was 25,681.43 Lakhs. Basic and diluted earnings per share for continuing operations was 109.74. The group discontinued its fabric manufacturing operations effective July 20, 2026. The fabric segment is now classified as a discontinued operation.
